item.title: President Lee: “If True, Stern Measures” over Alleged IKEA Parental Leave Disadvantages (李대통령, ‘이케아 육아휴직 불이익’ 의혹에 “사실이라면 엄정 조치”)
item.description:
President Lee: “If True, Stern Measures” over Alleged IKEA Parental Leave Disadvantages (李대통령, ‘이케아 육아휴직 불이익’ 의혹에 “사실이라면 엄정 조치”)

President Lee Jae-myung shared a media report on the 10th stating that the Ministry of Employment and Labor has launched an investigation into allegations that Swedish furniture company IKEA demoted and pressured a returning employee after parental leave to resign voluntarily, saying, “We will thoroughly investigate, and if it is confirmed to be true, we will take stern measures in accordance with international standards.” (이재명 대통령은 10일 스웨덴 가구 기업 이케아(IKEA)가 육아 휴직을 쓰고 돌아온 직원의 직급을 강등하고 권고사직을 종용했다는 의혹이 있어 고용노동부가 조사에 나섰다는 내용의 언론 보도를 공유하면서 “철저히 조사해서 사실로 밝혀진다면 국제적 기준에 맞게 엄정하게 조치하겠다”고 했다.)

President Lee, who is on a state visit to Mongolia, stated in a post on X (formerly Twitter) that morning, “Just as our companies should not engage in anti-labor, irrational behavior abroad, foreign companies should not do so here either.” (몽골 국빈 방문 중인 이 대통령은 이날 오전 X(옛 트위터)에 올린 글에서 “우리 기업도 해외에서 반노동 비상식 행태를 보여서는 안 되는 것처럼 외국 기업도 국내에서 그래선 안 된다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

President Lee said, “There was a time when a globally exemplary company in other countries caused backlash by engaging in anti-labor and opaque management practices specifically in our country,” adding, “While that was an era when our government pursued anti-labor policies and was tainted with corruption, now that South Korea is transforming into a model society and government leading the world, such outdated management practices cannot be tolerated if they occur.” (이 대통령은 “한때 다른 나라에선 모범적인 글로벌 기업이 유독 우리나라에서만 반노동적이고 불투명한 경영을 해서 빈축을 사는 경우가 있었다”며 “우리나라 정부가 반노동 정책을 구사하고 부정부패로 물들어 있던 시절의 이야기지만, 이제는 대한민국이 세계를 선도하는 모범 사회, 모범 정부로 거듭나고 있는데 그러한 구태 경영 행태가 발생한다면 용납할 수 없다”고 했다.)

item.title: Internal Opposition Rises Within Ruling Party Over Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Powers... "Some Exceptions Must Be Allowed" (보완수사권 폐지에 與 내부 반기… “일부 예외 인정해야”)
item.description:
Internal Opposition Rises Within Ruling Party Over Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Powers... "Some Exceptions Must Be Allowed" (보완수사권 폐지에 與 내부 반기… “일부 예외 인정해야”)

While the Democratic Party of Korea effectively proposed a revision to the Criminal Procedure Act as a party line on the 9th, which would completely abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers and only retain the right to request supplementary investigations, claims have emerged within the Democratic Party itself that "the supplementary investigation powers should be partially preserved." (더불어민주당이 검찰의 보완수사권을 완전히 폐지하고 보완수사 요구권만 남기는 내용의 형사소송법 개정안을 지난 9일 사실상 당론으로 발의한 가운데, 민주당 내에서도 “보완수사권을 일부 존치해야 한다”는 주장이 나왔다.)

Democratic Party lawmaker Hong Ki-won said in an interview with KBS Radio's "Jeon Gyeok Si-sa" on the 10th, "The bill proposed by the party yesterday seems to have put in place many safety measures to address the absence of supplementary investigation powers, but it cannot fundamentally resolve the problems that arise when those powers are abolished." He added, "There are cases where the supplementary investigation powers must be partially preserved." <<> Lawmaker Hong stated, "If supplementary investigations are completely prohibited, the number of requests for supplementary investigations will increase significantly," and "Inevitably, the investigation period will become longer in the future." He explained, "Crime victims such as children, the elderly, and the disabled have limited ability to protect themselves. If the police get the initial direction wrong or fail to listen to the victims' claims, there is a high likelihood of distortion." He further noted, "If a prosecutor cannot directly conduct a supplementary investigation, they must request the responsible investigator to redo and supplement the investigation, but that is not easy. Changing the direction of one's own investigation to pursue a new path is challenging." <<> He said, "In detention cases, the detention period is usually 20 days, or 30 days if extended, and requesting a supplementary investigation to handle it could take a lot of time. There could be many cases that inevitably end up as non-detention indictments." He added, "There are also cases where the statute of limitations is imminent. Going through the process of requesting a supplementary investigation could cause the statute of limitations to expire." Furthermore, he noted, "There are cases that require a consolidated investigation. Requesting each police station to supplement and reinvestigate could lead to difficulties." <<> The National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee will convene a subcommittee on bill review this day to begin discussions on bills that include the abolition of supplementary investigation powers. Lawmaker Hong said, "I have only argued that deliberation is necessary until now, but since bills that completely abolish supplementary investigation powers have already been proposed, discussions are progressing rapidly. I have been preparing to propose a bill, thinking that I need to present an alternative to continue this argument. The gist of it is to partially preserve the supplementary investigation powers." <<> He elaborated, "It's basically about making supplementary investigation requests the principle, but recognizing exceptions so that prosecutors can conduct supplementary investigations in specific cases." These cases include "crimes targeting socially vulnerable groups, some livelihood-related cases, detention cases or cases where the statute of limitations is imminent, and cases that require a consolidated investigation of incidents occurring simultaneously in multiple locations." He added, "It should be done by obtaining approval from the local chief prosecutor and having the civilian-based Case Review Committee of the prosecution office review whether the prosecutor's supplementary investigation is appropriate." <<> Lawmaker Hong stated, "President Lee Jae-myung also said in March that 'completely abolishing the prosecutor's supplementary investigation powers could cause problems.'" He added, "I believe he intended to convey that the supplementary investigation powers should be partially preserved and that the National Assembly should deliberate and handle it properly." (홍기원 민주당 의원은 10일 KBS라디오 전격시사 인터뷰에서 “어제 당에서 발의한 법안의 내용이 보완수사권이 없을 경우에 여러 안전장치를 많이 마련한 것 같기는 한데, 보완수사권을 폐지했을 때 생기는 그런 문제들을 본질적으로 해소할 수는 없다”며 “보완수사권을 일부 존치해야만 하는 그런 사안들이 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: "AI is Now a Core Competency for Public Service" – PM’s Drive Spurs Prime Minister’s Office to Launch ‘AI Morning Lecture’ (“이제 AI가 공직사회 기본 역량” 韓총리 드라이브에 총리실 ‘AI 아침 강연’까지)
item.description:
"AI is Now a Core Competency for Public Service" – PM’s Drive Spurs Prime Minister’s Office to Launch ‘AI Morning Lecture’ (“이제 AI가 공직사회 기본 역량” 韓총리 드라이브에 총리실 ‘AI 아침 강연’까지)

The Prime Minister’s Office has launched an ‘AI Morning Lecture’ series for its staff, marking the inauguration of Prime Minister Han Sung-sook, who emphasizes the transition to an ‘AI-driven government.’ (국무총리실이 ‘AI(인공지능) 활용 정부’로의 전환을 강조하는 한성숙 총리의 취임을 계기로 총리실 직원들을 대상으로 ‘AI 아침 강연’을 시작했다.)

On the 10th, at 8 AM in the Seoul Government Complex, the Prime Minister’s Office invited Lee Seung-hyun, CEO of Alphacap Lab and author of ‘AI National Wealth,’ to deliver a lecture on the theme of ‘Understanding the AI Era and Strategies for Rapid Spread of Public AX (AI Transformation).’ Prime Minister Han, along with key officials and staff including Deputy Prime Minister for Economic Affairs and Office for Government Policy Coordination head Yun Chang-ryeol, attended. (총리실은 10일 오전 8시 정부서울청사에서 ‘AI 국부론’의 저자인 이승현 알파카랩 대표를 불러 ‘AI 시대 이해 및 공공 AX(인공지능 전환) 속도감 있는 확산 전략’을 주제로 강연을 들었다. 한 총리와 윤창렬 국무조정실장 등 총리실 주요 간부와 직원들이 참석했다.)

CEO Lee emphasized, "We have entered an era where AI is not just a simple work tool but an ‘AI Agent’ that collaborates with humans," adding, "For the public sector to lead the AI transformation, the Prime Minister’s Office must present a data roadmap through inter-ministerial coordination and proactively overhaul infrastructure and systems." (이 대표는 “AI가 단순한 업무 도구를 넘어 사람과 함께 일하는 ‘AI 에이전트’ 시대로 진입했다”며 “공공 부문이 AI 대전환을 선도해 나가기 위해서는 총리실이 부처 간 조정을 통해 데이터 로드맵을 제시하고, 선제적으로 인프라와 제도를 정비해야 한다”고 강조했다.)

During the subsequent Q&A session, staff raised practical questions such as, "What role should the Prime Minister’s Office play when AI policies are being implemented across multiple ministries?" and "How should policy coordination change using AI?" (이어진 질의응답 시간에는 ‘AI 정책이 여러 부처에 걸쳐 추진되는 상황에서 총리실이 어떤 역할을 해야 하는지’ ‘AI를 활용한 정책 조정은 어떻게 달라져야 하는지’ 등에 관한 실무자들의 질문이 이어졌다.)

Prime Minister Han stressed, "AI innovation is no longer an option but a fundamental competency of the public service," and "The Prime Minister’s Office must first understand and actively utilize AI to create a new model of inter-ministerial collaboration and policy coordination." She also urged, "Employees should actively use AI as a daily work partner to create administrative innovation that citizens can truly feel." (한 총리는 “AI 혁신은 더 이상 선택이 아닌 공직 사회의 기본 역량”이라며 “총리실이 먼저 AI를 이해하고 적극 활용해 부처 간 협업과 정책 조정의 새로운 모델을 만들어 나가야 한다”고 강조했다. 그러면서 “직원들도 AI를 일상적인 업무 파트너로 적극 활용해 국민이 체감할 수 있는 행정 혁신을 만들어 달라”고 당부했다.)

The Prime Minister’s Office explained that this lecture was "prepared as part of an effort to elevate the office into an organization equipped with AI capabilities, in line with Han Sung-sook’s inauguration as the ‘AI Innovation Prime Minister.’" The office stated, "Through these lectures, we aim to enhance employees’ understanding of AI change trends and public AX, and to substantively support the pursuit of ‘AI Transformation,’ a key agenda of Prime Minister Han. We plan to hold ongoing lectures focusing on various topics such as public AX, data, and bio." (총리실은 이번 강연을 “한성숙 ‘AI 혁신 총리’ 취임을 계기로 총리실이 AI 역량을 갖춘 조직으로 발돋움하기 위한 일환으로 준비했다”고 설명했다. 총리실은 “강연을 통해 직원들의 AI 변화 양상과 공공 AX에 대한 이해도를 높이고, 한 총리의 핵심 어젠다인 ‘AI 대전환’ 추진을 내실 있게 뒷받침해 나갈 계획”이라며 “공공 AX, 데이터, 바이오 등 다양한 주제를 중심으로 강연을 지속적으로 개최할 예정”이라고 했다.)

Prime Minister Han, a former IT journalist and internet company executive, has positioned herself as a prime minister leading innovation in both the public and private sectors based on AI technology. In her inaugural address on the 2nd, she declared, "I will ensure that South Koreans can utilize AI better than anyone else in the world," pledging to build an AI ecosystem and ‘rationalize’ regulations that hinder it. The government also vowed to become the ‘government that best utilizes AI,’ promising full-scale adoption of AI systems for work tasks and the expansion of the connection and openness of government-held data. (IT 전문 기자와 인터넷 기업 간부 출신인 한 총리는 AI 기술을 바탕으로 공공과 민간 부문 혁신을 이끄는 총리가 되겠다고 자임하고 있다. 한 총리는 지난 2일 취임사에서 “대한민국 국민이 세계에서 AI를 가장 잘 활용할 수 있도록 하겠다”며, AI 생태계를 구축하고 이를 가로막는 규제는 ‘합리화’하겠다고 했다. 정부도 ‘AI를 가장 잘 활용하는 정부’로 만들겠다며 업무용 AI 시스템 전면 도입, 정부가 보유한 데이터의 연결과 개방 확대를 약속했다.)

On the 9th, during her first national policy coordination meeting as prime minister, she adopted the ‘Strategy for Realizing an AI Democratic Government.’ The plan includes making administrative information AI-friendly and open, reducing unnecessary labor for public officials through AI, and leveraging AI for communication between citizens and public officials as well as for public services. (지난 9일에는 총리 취임 후 처음으로 주재한 국가 정책 조정 회의에서 ‘AI민주정부 실현 전략’을 채택했다. 행정 정보를 AI 친화적으로 개방하고, AI를 활용해 공직자의 불필요한 노동을 줄이며, 국민과 공직자의 소통과 대국민 서비스에도 AI를 활용하겠다는 계획이다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon: "Reform Party Must Reveal When They Knew Jeong Yi-han's 'Self-Staged' Incident" Lee Jun-seok: "Completely Unaware During Election Period" (한동훈 “개혁신당, 정이한 ‘자작극’ 인지 시점 밝혀야” 이준석 “선거 기간 중 전혀 몰랐다”)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon: "Reform Party Must Reveal When They Knew Jeong Yi-han's 'Self-Staged' Incident" Lee Jun-seok: "Completely Unaware During Election Period" (한동훈 “개혁신당, 정이한 ‘자작극’ 인지 시점 밝혀야” 이준석 “선거 기간 중 전혀 몰랐다”)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon stated on the 10th, in response to media reports that police were aware of Reform Party candidate Jeong Yi-han's "self-staged terrorist" incident before the June 3 by-elections, that "the police and the Reform Party must clarify when they knew that this was a self-staged act." (무소속 한동훈 의원은 10일 경찰이 개혁신당 정이한 후보의 ‘테러 자작극’을 6·3 지방선거 이전에 인지했다는 언론 보도와 관련해 “경찰과 개혁신당은 ‘자작극이라는 사실’을 언제 알았는지 밝혀야 한다”고 했다.)

In a Facebook post on the same day, lawmaker Han said, "Candidate Jeong received more votes than he would have otherwise due to sympathy over the terrorist attack, and Busan citizens were deceived into voting, having their voting rights stolen." He added, "If it had been known before the election that the terrorist act was self-staged, far fewer Busan citizens would have voted for Candidate Jeong, and the (Busan mayoral) election results could have changed." He continued, "If the police knew before the election that it was a self-staged act, they should have disclosed that fact, and the Reform Party should have confessed and withdrawn its candidate." (한 의원은 이날 페이스북 글에서 “정 후보는 테러 동정심으로 자신이 받을 수 있었던 표보다 더 득표했고, 부산 시민들은 속아서 투표해 투표권을 강탈당했다”며 “테러가 자작극이라는 사실을 선거 전에 알았다면 정 후보에게 투표할 부산시민은 훨씬 적었을 것이고, (부산시장) 선거 결과가 바뀌었을 수도 있다”고 했다. 이어 “경찰이 자작극이라는 사실을 선거 전에 알았다면 그 사실을 알렸어야 했고, 개혁신당은 그 사실을 고백하고 후보를 사퇴시켰어야 했다”고 했다.)

Lawmaker Han remarked, "I pointed out in an interview right after the June election that if the police had known it was a self-staged act but did not investigate or disclose it, that would constitute police interference in the election." He added, "If they knew before the election, the police and the Reform Party must take responsibility for infringing on the voting rights of Busan citizens." (한 의원은 “지난 6월 선거 직후 인터뷰에서 경찰이 자작극이라는 사실을 파악하고도 수사·공개하지 않았다면 경찰의 선거개입이라고 지적했었다”며 “선거 전에 알았다면 경찰과 개혁신당은 부산시민의 참정권을 침해한 책임을 져야 한다”고 했다.)

In response, Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok told reporters on the same day, "I had no idea at all (about Candidate Jeong's crime during the election period)," and asked, "How could such a person have told us (that he was a suspect)? Also, didn't the police say they didn't officially notify us?" Leader Lee stated, "Some politicians may raise suspicions, but we were unable to know, and we did not know." (이에 대해 개혁신당 이준석 대표는 이날 기자들과 만나 “(선거 기간 정 후보의 범행을) 전혀 몰랐다”며 “그런 사람이 저희에게 (피의자 신분임을) 얘기해줬을리도 만무하고, 경찰도 공식적으로 저희에게 통보 안 했다고 하지 않느냐”고 했다. 이 대표는 “일부 정치인이 의혹을 제기할 수는 있지만, 저희는 인지할 수도 없었고 인지하지 않았다”고 했다.)

item.title: At Supreme Council, Pro-Myeong and Pro-Cheong Clash Over Preferential Voting… "Re-discuss Tonight" (與 최고위서 친명·친청 선호투표제 설전...“밤에 재논의”)
item.description:
At Supreme Council, Pro-Myeong and Pro-Cheong Clash Over Preferential Voting… "Re-discuss Tonight" (與 최고위서 친명·친청 선호투표제 설전...“밤에 재논의”)

The Democratic Party of Korea discussed whether to introduce a preferential voting system for the party leadership election at the August 17 National Convention during a Supreme Council meeting but failed to reach a conclusion. The pro-Myeong (pro-Lee Jae-myung) faction, which demands the introduction of the preferential voting system, and the opposing pro-Cheong (pro-Jung Cheong-rae) faction engaged in a heated verbal exchange during the open session. (더불어민주당이 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거에 선호투표제를 도입할지 여부를 최고위원회의에서 논의했으나 결론을 내리지 못했다. 선호투표제 도입을 요구하는 친명(친이재명)계와 이에 반대하는 친청(친정청래)계는 공개 회의에서 설전을 벌였다.)

On the morning of the 10th, the Democratic Party held a closed-door Supreme Council meeting to discuss the preferential voting system and the introduction of elected youth supreme council members, but failed to narrow their differences. Senior Spokesperson Kang Joon-hyun stated, "Acting Leader and Floor Leader Han Byung-do said, 'We will reach a conclusion in some form today,'" and added, "We will reconvene the Supreme Council tonight to make a decision." (민주당은 10일 오전 비공개 최고위원회의를 열고 선호투표제, 선출직 청년최고위원 도입 여부를 논의했지만, 이견을 좁히지 못했다. 강준현 수석대변인은 “한병도 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표가 ‘오늘 어떤 형태로든 결론을 내겠다’고 했다”면서 “오늘 밤 다시 최고위를 열어 결정하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

The preferential voting system is a method where voters list candidates in order of preference as 1st, 2nd, and 3rd on the ballot. If no candidate receives a majority, the votes of the lowest-ranked candidate are redistributed to their next preferred candidates. Previously, the party's National Convention Preparation Committee decided to adopt this system for the upcoming convention, but it has yet to be approved by the Supreme Council due to opposition from the pro-Cheong faction. While pro-Myeong figures like former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and lawmaker Song Young-gil welcome the preferential voting system, former leader Jung Cheong-rae opposes it, calling it a "violation of the party constitution and rules." (선호투표제는 유권자가 선호도에 따라 투표용지에 1·2·3 순위 후보를 적고, 과반 득표자가 없으면 최하위 득표자의 차순위 후보를 합산하는 방식이다. 앞서 민주당 ‘전당대회준비위원회(전준위)’는 이번 전당대회에 선호투표제를 도입하기로 결정했지만, 친청계 반발로 최고위 의결을 받지 못하고 있다. 친명계인 김민석 전 국무총리와 송영길 의원은 선호투표제를 환영한다는 입장인 반면, 정청래 전 대표는 “당헌·당규 위반”이라며 반대하고 있다.)

During the Supreme Council meeting that day, the pro-Myeong and pro-Cheong factions exchanged sharp remarks. Pro-Myeong Supreme Council member Hwang Myung-sun said, "Everyone agreed to this a year ago, and former leader Lee Jae-myung introduced this system after deep consideration. Now, they're shaking it because it disadvantages a specific candidate. This is the start of turning the party into a private organization by flipping the rules based on self-interest, and it is absolutely unacceptable." Supreme Council member Kang Deuk-gu, who is close to former Prime Minister Kim, also stated, "The preferential voting system does not violate the party constitution or rules. The party rules clearly state that the floor leader election can be conducted using preferential voting or other methods. This was already approved by the Party Affairs Committee last year as the method for electing the party leader." Kang shook the meeting minutes from last year's Party Affairs Committee and asked, "Why has a norm that caused no problems for a year suddenly become a violation of the party constitution and rules?" (이날 최고위에서도 친명계와 친청계는 날 선 말을 주고받았다. 친명계 황명선 최고위원은 “1년 전 모두가 찬성했고 이재명 당시 대표께서 고심 끝에 도입한 이 제도(선호투표제)를 이제 와서 특정 후보에게 불리하다는 이유로 흔들고 있다”면서 “당의 룰을 유불리에 따라 뒤집으려는 사당화의 시작으로 결코 용납될 수 없다”고 했다. 김 전 총리와 가까운 강득구 최고위원도 “선호투표제는 당헌·당규 위반이 아니다”라면서 “원내대표 선거를 선호투표 등 방법으로 실시할 수 있다고 당규에 분명히 명시돼 있다. 지난해 당무위에서 당대표 선출 방식으로 이미 의결된 바 있다”고도 했다. 강 최고위원은 당시 당무위 회의록을 흔들며 “1년 동안 아무 문제가 없던 규범이 갑자기 당헌·당규 위반이 되는 이유가 무엇이냐”고도 했다.)

In contrast, pro-Cheong Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yoon said, "The party constitution is our party's constitution," and argued, "To introduce a preferential voting system that clearly violates the party constitution and rules, we must first amend the party constitution and rules, just as President Lee Jae-myung did." Supreme Council member Moon Jeong-bok also remarked, "I am curious about the ulterior motive behind insisting on preserving a system with identified flaws as if it were a golden rule." (반면 친청계 이성윤 최고위원은 “당헌은 우리 당의 헌법”이라면서 “명백하게 당헌·당규에 위반되는 선호 투표제를 도입하려면 이재명 대통령이 하셨던 것처럼 당헌·당규를 개정해야 한다”고 했다. 문정복 최고위원도 “오류가 발견된 제도를 금과옥조처럼 지키려고 하는 저의가 궁금하다”고 했다.)

Another pro-Cheong member, Supreme Council member Park Gyu-hwan, stated, "The behavior of covertly undermining the party constitution to pursue private interests must end. Only those who lack the ability to innovate the party or the will to carry on its legacy and traditions would divide party members and sow hatred for their own petty gains." (역시 친청인 박규환 최고위원은 “음험하게 당헌을 훼손하면서까지 사사로운 이익을 도모하는 행태는 사라져야 한다”면서 “당을 혁신할 실력도, 당의 유산과 전통을 이어갈 의지도 없는 세력만이 알량한 자기 이익을 위해 당원을 편 가르고 혐오를 심는 법”이라고 하기도 했다.)

Meanwhile, pro-Myeong Supreme Council members Kang Deuk-gu and Hwang Myung-sun called for the resignation of pro-Cheong Supreme Council members shortly after the meeting ended, speaking with reporters. They claimed that the pro-Cheong Supreme Council members plan to run as candidates for supreme council member or provincial party chairperson in the next national convention, stating, "It's like a player running the race making the rules when those intending to run discuss election regulations." (한편 친명계인 강득구·황명선 최고위원은 최고위원회의 종료 직후 기자들과 만나 친청계 최고위원들의 사퇴를 요구했다. 두 사람은 친청계 최고위원들이 차기 전당대회에 최고위원 또는 도당위원장 후보로 출마할 예정이라면서, “출마 예정자가 선출 규정을 논의하는 것은 경기 뛰는 선수가 룰을 만드는 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: “Han Dong-hoon was expelled for criminal acts, not acts harmful to the party” (장동혁 “한동훈, 해당행위 아닌 범죄행위로 제명당한 것”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk: “Han Dong-hoon was expelled for criminal acts, not acts harmful to the party” (장동혁 “한동훈, 해당행위 아닌 범죄행위로 제명당한 것”)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk stated on the 10th, “People keep saying we should embrace them and not engage in subtractive politics, but those who point guns at their own side are a minus,” reiterating his resolve to establish party discipline through disciplinary measures. (국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 10일 “계속해서 ‘끌어안아야 된다’ ‘뺄셈 정치 하지 마라’고 하는데 우리 편을 향해 총을 쏘는 사람은 마이너스”라며 징계를 통한 당 기강 확립 의지를 재차 드러냈다.)

Appearing on Newdaily’s YouTube channel that day, Representative Jang said, “Calling for the removal of those who aim guns at us is being unconditionally labeled as subtractive politics, but it’s actually telling us not to take such (disciplinary) action that constitutes subtractive politics.” (장 대표는 이날 뉴데일리 유튜브에 출연해 “우리한테 총부리를 겨누는 사람을 정리를 해야 된다고 하는 것을 무조건 뺄셈 정치라고 하는데 그런 거(징계) 하지 말라고 이야기하는 게 뺄셈 정치”라며 이처럼 말했다.)

He remarked, “A ragtag army cannot win a war.” He added, “What’s more important is whether we can unite as a single force and fight together. If we have 100 people, but 20 of them are shooting at their own side, I believe those 20 are worse than having none at all.” (그는 “오합지졸 같은 병사로는 전쟁에서 승리할 수 없다”고 말했다. 이어 “단일 대오로 뭉쳐 하나로 힘을 모아서 싸울 수 있는 그런 조직이냐가 더 중요하다”며 “100명이 있지만 20명이 자기 편을 향해서 총을 쏘는 사람이 있다면 저는 그 20명은 없는 것만 못하다는 생각을 하고 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding candidates who left the party to run as independents, Representative Jang said, “They can never be part of our party again.” He explained, “In the course of this local election, there have been many cases where candidates left the party, ran as independents, won, and our party’s candidate lost. At the time, many lawmakers demanded that we must send a strong message permanently banning those who left for independent runs from ever rejoining. Only then would they stop aiding these individuals and instead support our party’s candidates.” (장 대표는 탈당해 무소속으로 출마한 후보에 대해서는 “영원히 우리 당의 같은 일원이 될 수 없다”고 했다. 그는 “이번 지방선거 과정에서 탈당해서 무소속으로 출마해 그 후보가 당선되고 우리 당 후보가 떨어진 경우들이 많이 있다”며 “당시 많은 의원님들이 ‘지금 탈당해서 무소속 출마한 사람들에 대해서 영원히 복당을 금지한다고 강하게 메시지를 내야만 한다. 그래야 이 사람들을 돕지 않고 우리 당 후보를 돕게 된다’고 요구했었다”고 말했다.)

He thus hinted at banning independents from rejoining the party. He stated, “When people leave the party and run as independents, we’ve threatened strong discipline and expulsion, but in the end, we’ve allowed them back by saying, ‘We must embrace everyone’ and ‘We need unity,’ so no one fears the consequences. I don’t think we should operate the party with the mindset that we can just accept them back and, if we lack numbers, make them our candidates again.” Previously, Representative Jang had appointed former Supreme Council member Jang Ye-chan, who ran as an independent after having his nomination revoked in the 2024 general election, as deputy director of the Yeouido Research Institute late last year. (그러면서 무소속 출마한 인사에 대해서는 복당 금지를 시사했다. 그는 “탈당 후 무소속 출마하는 경우 강하게 징계하고 제명할 것처럼 하다가 결국 ‘우리가 다 끌어안아야 한다’ ‘통합해야 한다’고 해서 복당해 주고 그렇게 해 왔기 때문에 아무도 두려워하지 않는다”며 “(탈당 후 출마했던 사람들을) 그냥 받아주고 사람 없으면 결국 또 우리 후보로 만들면 된다는 생각을 가지고 당을 운영해서는 저는 안 된다고 생각한다”고 했다. 앞서 장 대표는 2024년 총선 당시 공천이 취소돼 무소속으로 출마했던 장예찬 전 최고위원을 작년 말 여의도연구원 부원장직에 임명했었다.)

However, he drew a line, saying his remarks about a “permanent ban on rejoining” were not aimed at independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon. Representative Jang had previously stated at a closed-door Supreme Council meeting on the 6th, “For serious acts harmful to the party, we should revise the party constitution and rules to permanently ban those individuals from rejoining.” (다만 그는 자신의 ‘영구 복당 금지’ 발언이 무소속 한동훈 의원을 겨냥한 것은 아니라고 선을 그었다. 앞서 장 대표는 지난 6일 당 비공개 최고위원회의에서 “심각한 해당 행위에 대해선 당헌·당규를 개정해서라도 복당을 영구 금지해야 한다”고 발언했었다.)

When asked if this was targeting Han, Representative Jang said, “That’s jumping too far ahead,” adding, “Lawmaker Han was expelled for criminal acts, not for acts harmful to the party.” He further noted, “The ‘party member bulletin board’ issue is a criminal act, not related to a ‘permanent ban on rejoining for those who committed acts harmful to the party.’” (장 대표는 한 의원을 겨냥한 것이냐는 질문에 “너무 앞서 나간 것”이라며 “한 의원은 범죄 행위로 제명을 당한 것이지 해당(害黨) 행위로 제명을 당한 것이 아니다”라고 했다. 그러면서 “‘당원 게시판’ 문제는 범죄 행위지 ‘해당 행위자 복당 영구 금지’에 해당하지 않는다”고 했다.)

Regarding the ballot shortage incident and the reform of the National Election Commission (NEC), he said, “South Korea’s NEC is hopeless; only a special counsel is the answer.” He added, “When ballot boxes were moved to Olympic Park, they were moved by police without NEC officials present, contaminating them. I consider them not ballot boxes but ‘trash bins’ or ‘garbage cans’ filled with unusable ballots. I believe a complete re-election is necessary.” (그는 투표용지 부족 사태와 중앙선거관리위원회 개혁 문제와 관련해서는 “대한민국 선관위는 노답이다, 특검만이 답이다”라고 했다. 그러면서 “올림픽공원에 투표함 옮길 때 선관위원 없이 경찰이 옮겼기 때문에 오염된 투표함”이라며 “투표함이 아니라 못 쓰는 투표용지가 들어간 ‘쓰레기함’, ‘쓰레기통’이라고 생각한다. 전면 재선거를 해야 한다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Defense Ministry: “Claims of Minister Ahn’s Desertion Are Clearly False… Will Request Correction of Records After Tenure” (국방부 “安장관 탈영 주장 허위…퇴임후 기록 정정 청구할 것")
item.description:
Defense Ministry: “Claims of Minister Ahn’s Desertion Are Clearly False… Will Request Correction of Records After Tenure” (국방부 “安장관 탈영 주장 허위…퇴임후 기록 정정 청구할 것")

The Ministry of National Defense stated on the 10th regarding suspicions that Minister Ahn Gyu-back had absented himself from his duty post while serving as a reserve soldier that “the (claim of) desertion is clearly false,” and that once the minister’s term ends, he will request a correction of the error in his military service record. (국방부는 안규백 장관이 방위병으로 복무하면서 근무지를 이탈했다는 의혹과 관련해 “탈영 (주장)은 명백한 허위”라며 장관 임기가 끝나면 병적기록 오류에 대해 정정을 청구하겠다고 10일 밝혔다.)

A Defense Ministry official told reporters on the same day, “The claim of desertion is clearly false.” (국방부 관계자는 이날 기자들과 만나 “탈영 (주장은) 명백한 허위”라고 했다.)

The official added, “According to the Sungkyunkwan University academic records disclosed by Rep. Han Ki-ho (during the confirmation hearing), it is clear that (Minister Ahn) enlisted on November 5, 1983, and was discharged on January 4, 1985. If the claim that he deserted and served an additional seven months were true, I would ask how he could have had a university transcript for the first semester of 1985.” (이 관계자는 “(인사청문회 당시) 한기호 의원이 공개한 성균관대 학적부에 따르면 1983년 11월 5일 입대해 1985년 1월 4일 제대 사실이 분명하다”라며 “탈영해서 추가복무를 7개월 했다는 주장이 사실이라면 어떻게 1985년 1학기 대학 성적이 있는지 반문하고 싶다”고 했다.)

It is known that Minister Ahn’s period of service as a reserve soldier is recorded in his military service record as 22 months, not the usual 14 months. During the confirmation hearing in July of last year, the opposition raised suspicions of absence from duty or confinement to the guardhouse. The controversy, which quieted down after the confirmation hearing, flared up again on the 6th when Kim Young-soo, a retired Navy lieutenant commander and head of the ‘Public Interest Reporting Center for a Clean Society,’ held a press conference at the National Assembly to publicly raise the issue. (안 장관의 방위병 복무 기간은 통상적인 14개월이 아닌 22개월로 병적기록부에 기록돼 있는 것으로 알려졌다. 이에 지난해 7월 인사청문회 당시 야당에서는 근무지 이탈 혹은 영창 입소 의혹을 제기했다. 인사청문회 이후 잦아들었던 논란은 지난 6일 예비역 해군 소령인 김영수 ‘청렴사회를 위한 공익신고센터’ 센터장이 국회 기자회견을 열고 공개 문제제기를 하며 다시 불거졌다.)

Lieutenant Commander Kim claims that Minister Ahn, after being called up as a reserve soldier in November 1983 and serving in a company in Daesan-myeon, Gochang County, North Jeolla Province, under the Army’s 35th Infantry Division, illegally absented himself from military duty for about seven months. Kim asserts that Minister Ahn was then detained for 30 days and subsequently served an additional seven months, resulting in a total service period of 22 months. (김 소장은 안 장관이 1983년 11월 방위병으로 소집돼 육군 제35사단 전북 고창군 대산면 중대에서 복무하던 중 약 7개월간 위법적으로 군무를 이탈했다고 주장하고 있다. 김 소장은 안 장관이 30일 구금됐고 이후 7개월을 더 복무하면서 복무기간이 22개월이 됐다는 것이다.)

In contrast, Minister Ahn explained during the confirmation hearing that, concerning an incident where his family provided lunch to active-duty soldiers in the unit during his service, he was investigated by military authorities for about three to four days. He said that in connection with this, after finishing the first semester of 1985, he worked for a ‘few more days’ during the summer break to complete that period. He explained that during this process, the final period of service was recorded as his discharge date, leading to a record showing he served approximately eight months longer than his actual service. (반면 안 장관은 인사청문회에서 복무 중 자신의 집안에서 부대 현역병에게 점심을 제공한 것과 관련해 군 관계기관의 조사를 3~4일 가량 받았고, 이와 관련해 1985년 1학기를 마치고 여름방학 중 해당 기간을 마저 채우기 위해 ‘며칠’ 더 근무했다고 설명했다. 이 과정에서 마지막 복무 시점이 전역일로 잡히면서 8개월 가량 더 복무한 것처럼 기록이 남았다는 것이다.)

The Defense Ministry has drawn a line on calls from some opposition quarters for the ‘disclosure of military service records’ to resolve suspicions. A Defense Ministry official explained, “If we were to disclose a 40-year-old erroneous record, wouldn’t that leave only the incorrect record in people’s minds, regardless of the facts?” adding, “We have not disclosed it because it would only fuel further misunderstanding.” (야권 일각에서 의혹 해소를 위해서는 ‘병적기록을 공개해야 한다’는 주장에 국방부는 선을 그었다. 국방부 관계자는 “40년 전 잘못된 기록을 공개한다면 사실관계와 상관없이 잘못된 기록만이 머리에 남지 않겠나”라며 “오해만 더 키울 것이어서 공개하지 않은 것”이라고 설명했다.)

Minister Ahn Gyu-back claims he first discovered the error in his military service record in 2016. However, he has not corrected the record to this day, nearly ten years later. Regarding the criticism of ‘If he is truly a victim of administrative error, why hasn’t he corrected his military service record?’, a Defense Ministry official stated, “If he were to request a correction while serving as the Minister of National Defense, mightn’t that spark other controversies?” adding, “He plans to request the correction and take additional measures after completing his duties and returning to a status without power.” (안규백 장관은 2016년 처음 병적 기록 오류를 발견했다고 주장하고 있다. 하지만 약 10년이 지난 지금까지도 병적기록을 정정하지 않고 있다. ‘정말 병무행정의 피해자라면 왜 병적 기록을 정정하지 않느냐’라고 지적에 대해 국방부 관계자는 “국방장관 신분으로 정정 청구를 한다면 또 다른 논란이 나올 수 있지 않겠나”라며 “부여된 일을 마치고 권력이 없는 신분으로 돌아갈 때 정정 청구 및 추가 조치를 할 계획”이라고 말했다.)

Within the Defense Ministry, it has been reported that there are concerns that if the incumbent minister requested a correction of his military service record, the opposition could raise issues, claiming that the relevant Defense Ministry departments and the Military Manpower Administration, which handle the practical work, had not processed it fairly. (국방부 내에는 현직 장관 신분으로 병적기록 수정을 요구할 경우 실무를 담당하는 국방부 관련 부서와 병무청이 공정하게 처리하지 않았다며 야권에서 문제제기를 할 수 있다는 우려가 있는 것으로 전해졌다.)

Minister Ahn, who returned to Korea on the 10th after a business trip to NATO (North Atlantic Treaty Organization), has not issued any messages regarding the suspicions of absence from military duty or the issue of unifying the service academies. (안 장관은 10일 나토(북대서양조약기구) 출장을 마치고 귀국했지만 군무 이탈 의혹이나 사관학교 통합과 관련한 메시지는 내지 않고 있다.)

item.title: President Lee Appoints Vice Minister of Planning and Budget Lim Ki-geun as New Chief of Office for Government Policy Coordination (李대통령, 신임 국무조정실장에 임기근 기획예산처 차관 임명)
item.description:
President Lee Appoints Vice Minister of Planning and Budget Lim Ki-geun as New Chief of Office for Government Policy Coordination (李대통령, 신임 국무조정실장에 임기근 기획예산처 차관 임명)

President Lee Jae-myung appointed Lim Ki-geun, Vice Minister of the Ministry of Planning and Budget, as the new Chief of the Office for Government Policy Coordination (ministerial level) on the 10th. (이재명 대통령은 10일 신임 국무조정실장(장관급)에 임기근 기획예산처 차관을 임명했다.)

Cheong Wa Dae Senior Secretary for Public Relations and Communication Sung Ki-hong said in a briefing that afternoon, “New Chief Lim is a top expert in economic policy, having served as Director General for Policy Coordination at the Ministry of Economy and Finance, Deputy Minister for Budget Affairs, Commissioner of the Public Procurement Service, and Vice Minister of the Ministry of Planning and Budget.” He added, “Based on his experience in coordinating complex economic policies, we expect him to rationally adjust inter-ministerial interests and stably manage state affairs as the Chief of the Office for Government Policy Coordination.” (성기홍 청와대 홍보소통수석은 이날 오후 브리핑에서 “임 신임 실장은 기획재정부 정책조정국장, 예산총괄심의관, 조달청장, 기획예산처 차관 등을 거친 경제정책 분야 최고 전문가”라며 “복잡한 경제정책을 조율해 온 경험을 바탕으로 국무조정실장으로서 부처 간 이해관계를 합리적으로 조정하고, 국정 현안을 안정적으로 관리할 것으로 기대한다”고 했다.)

A native of Haenam, South Jeolla Province, Chief Lim graduated from Seoul National University's Department of Business Administration and, after passing the 36th Higher Civil Service Examination, has worked consistently in the budget sector of the Ministry of Economy and Finance. He served as Second Vice Minister of the Ministry of Economy and Finance, and after the ministry was split into the Ministry of Finance and Economy and the Ministry of Planning and Budget, he became Vice Minister of the Ministry of Planning and Budget. (전남 해남 출신인 임 실장은 서울대 경영학과를 나왔고, 36회 행정고시에 합격한 뒤 줄곧 기획재정부 예산 분야에서 일해왔다. 기재부 2차관으로 있다가, 기재부가 재정경제부와 기획예산처로 나뉜 뒤 기획예산처 차관으로 있었다.)

Previously, former Chief of the Office for Government Policy Coordination Yoon Chang-ryul expressed his intention to resign. Regarding the replacement of the chief, Senior Secretary Sung said, “Since the new Prime Minister has been appointed and started work, I understand that the former chief’s opinion that it would be desirable to work in sync with the new chief was respected.” <<>> (앞서 윤창렬 전 국무조정실장은 사의를 표했다. 국무조정실장 교체와 관련해, 성 수석은 “아무래도 새 국무총리가 임명되시고 일을 시작하셨기 때문에 새로운 국무조정실장을 통해서 호흡을 같이 하는 게 바람직하다는 전임 실장님의 의견이 존중된 것으로 알고 있다”고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee Visits Yi Tae-jun Memorial in Ulaanbaatar, Vows to ‘Carry Forward His Noble Spirit into the Korea-Mongolia Golden Age’ (李대통령, 울란바타르 이태준 열사 기념관 참배… “숭고한 뜻 ‘한몽 황금시대’로 이어갈 것”)
item.description:
President Lee Visits Yi Tae-jun Memorial in Ulaanbaatar, Vows to ‘Carry Forward His Noble Spirit into the Korea-Mongolia Golden Age’ (李대통령, 울란바타르 이태준 열사 기념관 참배… “숭고한 뜻 ‘한몽 황금시대’로 이어갈 것”)

<<>> President Lee Jae-myung, on a state visit to Mongolia, visited the Yi Tae-jun Memorial Park in downtown Ulaanbaatar on the 10th (local time) to honor the noble spirit of sacrifice of Martyr Yi Tae-jun, who contributed to the development of modern medicine in Mongolia and devoted himself to the independence of his homeland. ()

This year marks the 105th anniversary of the martyrdom of Yi Tae-jun. He sought asylum in Mongolia in 1914, opened a hospital called “Donguiuiguk,” and eradicated syphilis, a chronic disease in Mongolia at the time, serving as the royal physician to the Mongolian king. He was also a disciple of Dosan Ahn Chang-ho and a key independence activist who provided substantial financial support to independence movement groups such as the Uiyeoldan (Righteous Brotherhood). (몽골을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령은 10일(현지 시각) 울란바타르 시내에 있는 이태준 기념 공원을 찾아 몽골의 근대 의료 발전에 기여하고 조국의 독립을 위해 헌신한 이태준 열사의 숭고한 희생 정신을 기렸다.)

At 10:05 a.m. that day, President Lee arrived at the memorial park dressed in a dark suit and navy tie, greeted by cheers from local Koreans, including the head of the Korean Association. Standing before the symbolic grave and monument of Martyr Yi, President Lee laid a wreath of white lilies bearing the inscription “105th Anniversary of Martyr Yi Tae-jun’s Death, President of the Republic of Korea Lee Jae-myung,” and bowed his head in silent tribute as a requiem played. (올해로 순국 105주년을 맞이한 이태준 열사는 1914년 몽골로 망명해 병원 ‘동의의국’을 개업하고 당시 몽골의 고질병이었던 화류병을 퇴치해 몽골 국왕의 어의(御醫)로 활동한 인물이다. 동시에 도산 안창호 선생의 제자이자 의열단 등 독립운동 단체에 거액의 재정을 지원한 핵심 독립운동가다.)

Immediately after laying the wreath, President Lee showed deep interest by asking the defense attaché, who was guiding the event, about the exact location of the actual grave. The martyr’s remains are known to have been buried near the Jaiseng hill in the past, but the precise location remains unknown. President Lee carefully examined records left by Lyuh Woon-hyung, who had previously visited the martyr’s tomb, and urged continued efforts to verify historical facts for the complete restoration of this historical legacy. (이날 오전 10시 5분, 짙은색 양복에 네이비 넥타이 차림으로 기념 공원에 도착한 이 대통령은 현지 한인회장 등 동포들의 환호를 받으며 입장했다. 이 대통령은 이태준 선생의 가묘와 기념비 앞에 서서 ‘이태준 선생 순국 제105주년, 대한민국 대통령 이재명’이라고 적힌 흰 백합 화환을 헌화한 뒤, 울려 퍼지는 진혼곡에 맞춰 고개를 숙이고 묵념했다.)

President Lee then moved to the exhibition hall on the second floor of the memorial, where he viewed displays about the martyr’s life and independence movement activities, guided by an Independence Hall interpreter. He examined exhibits including a graduation photo from Severance Medical School, his connection with Ahn Chang-ho, and his special relationship with Kim Kyu-sik. (헌화 직후 이 대통령은 현장 안내를 맡은 국방무관에게 진짜 묘역의 위치를 물으며 깊은 관심을 보였다. 열사의 유해는 과거 자이승 구릉 인근에 묻힌 것으로 알려졌으나 정확한 위치는 미상인 상태다. 이 대통령은 여운형 선생이 과거 열사의 무덤을 참배하고 남긴 기록 등을 꼼꼼히 살피며, 역사적 유산의 완벽한 복원을 위한 지속적인 고증 노력을 당부했다.)

During his viewing of a report in the Independence Newspaper (under the “Geomauiyeon” column) detailing Yi Tae-jun’s financial support to independence movement groups, President Lee remarked, “Publishing the list of people who donated money to the independence movement in the newspaper like this would have leaked information to the Japanese colonial authorities, causing serious problems. I think the names in the reports were likely pseudonyms to avoid information leaks and surveillance.” At an AI-restored video display showing the martyr’s appearance, President Lee paused briefly and exclaimed, “It really looks like him.” (이어 이 대통령은 기념관 2층에 마련된 전시관으로 이동해 독립기념관 해설사의 안내에 따라 열사의 생애와 독립운동 자취를 관람했다. 세브란스 의학원 졸업 사진부터 안창호 선생과의 인연, 김규식 선생과의 특별한 관계 등을 담은 전시물을 둘러봤다.)

After completing the viewing, President Lee descended to the memorial lobby to sign the guestbook. He wrote, “I will carry forward Martyr Yi Tae-jun’s noble spirit into the Korea-Mongolia Golden Age.” (특히 이 대통령은 이태준 열사가 독립운동 단체에 재정을 지원한 내역이 담긴 독립신문 보도(거마의연 코너)를 관람하던 중 “독립운동에 돈을 낸 사람들의 명단을 이렇게 그대로 신문에 써놓으면 일제에 정보가 유출되어 심각한 문제가 생겼을 것”이라며 “보도 내용에 적힌 이름들은 정보 유출과 감시를 피하기 위해 가명을 사용한 것이 아닐까 생각한다”고 했다. 이어 이 대통령은 열사의 생전 모습을 인공지능(AI) 기술로 복원한 영상 전시 코너에서는 잠시 발걸음을 멈추고 “정말 닮았다”고 감탄하기도 했다.)

The ceremony was attended by a large number of key figures from the presidential office and cabinet, including Foreign Minister Cho Hyun, Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Kwon Oh-eul, National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac, and Ambassador to Mongolia Choi Jin-won. (관람을 마친 이 대통령은 기념관 로비로 내려와 방명록에 서명했다. 이 대통령은 ‘이태준 열사의 숭고한 뜻을 한몽 황금시대로 이어가겠습니다’라는 문구를 남겼다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Pioneering Spirit Resembling the Nomadic Spirit Cultivates 'Mongtan'... If You Rarely See the Ambassador, Tell Me Directly" (李대통령 “유목정신 닮은 개척정신이 ‘몽탄’ 일궈… 대사 안 보이면 내게 바로 말하라”)
item.description:
President Lee: "Pioneering Spirit Resembling the Nomadic Spirit Cultivates 'Mongtan'... If You Rarely See the Ambassador, Tell Me Directly" (李대통령 “유목정신 닮은 개척정신이 ‘몽탄’ 일궈… 대사 안 보이면 내게 바로 말하라”)

President Lee Jae-myung, on a state visit to Mongolia, held a luncheon meeting with compatriots at a hotel in downtown Ulaanbaatar on the afternoon of the 10th (local time), encouraging the Mongolian Korean community, which has built a vibrant Korean economic sphere in a harsh environment. At the event, President Lee promised to fully strengthen the support capabilities of local diplomatic missions for compatriots, based on the government-wide 'comprehensive survey of overseas compatriot complaints' being promoted since earlier this year. (몽골을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령은 10일 오후(현지 시각) 울란바타르 시내 한 호텔에서 동포 오찬 간담회를 열고, 척박한 환경 속에서 활기찬 한인 경제권을 일궈낸 재몽골 동포 사회를 격려했다. 이 대통령은 이 자리에서 올해 초부터 범정부 차원에서 추진 중인 ‘재외 동포 민원 전수조사’를 바탕으로 현지 공관의 동포 지원 역량을 전면 강화하겠다고 약속했다.)

Under the subtitle 'Compatriots Roaming the World are the Main Actors of Korea's Great Leap Forward,' the luncheon was attended by about 80 Mongolian Korean compatriots, along with senior government officials including Foreign Minister Cho Hyun, National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac, Deputy Prime Minister for Economy Koo Yun-cheol, Deputy Prime Minister for Science and Technology Bae Kyung-hoon, Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Kwon Oh-eul, and Overseas Koreans Agency Commissioner Kim Kyeong-hyeop. <<>= President Lee, wearing a black suit with a turquoise tie, entered alongside First Lady Kim Hye-kyung, who donned a violet jeogori (traditional jacket) and a white skirt, receiving a standing ovation from the compatriots. They accepted bouquets from children in hanbok and responded with bright smiles. <<>= In his encouragement speech, President Lee highly praised that, unlike typical inter-state exchanges, the Korea-Mongolia relationship has built a solid foundation through the voluntary dedication of compatriots, preceding government-level cooperation. President Lee noted, "Since diplomatic relations were established in 1990, even before full-scale government cooperation began, countless compatriots came to this land, built schools, shared technology, and founded businesses, fostering trust. As a result, Korean shops and enterprises have clustered in Ulaanbaatar, forming a vibrant economic sphere so much so that it's called 'Mongtan New City' (a blend of Dongtan and Mongolia)." <<>= He particularly highlighted the emotional and cultural 'similar temperaments' as the background for the rapid rapprochement between the people of both nations. President Lee said, "The nomadic spirit of Mongolians, who seek new paths across the vast steppes, and the unique pioneering spirit of Koreans, who take root and create paths anywhere in the world, are links that foster natural mutual understanding. Because of this enterprising spirit that challenges rather than stays put, compatriots have deeply rooted themselves in Mongolian society and served as excellent bridges between the two countries." <<>= He continued, "I will ensure that overseas diplomatic missions become a reliable platform and familiar neighbor that directly listens to your voices and seeks solutions together." President Lee looked at Ambassador Choi Jin-won of the Korean Embassy in Mongolia and joked, "If you find it hard to see the ambassador by your side regularly, just tell me directly." <<>= Earlier, in a welcoming speech, Cho Yoon-kyung, President of the Korean Association in Mongolia, said, "There's a joke among our compatriots that 'if you survive in Mongolia, you can survive anywhere in the world.' Just as the noble spirit of Lee Tae-joon, who served as a doctor and independence activist in Mongolia, forms a great foundation for Korea-Mongolia friendly cooperation, I ask for practical government attention and sustained budget support so that our Korean community can responsibly manage and preserve this legacy for future generations." <<>= Concluding his speech, President Lee expressed, "I will build a safer, more reliable, and prouder Korea so that the efforts and dedication of our compatriots are not in vain," and wished for the everlasting development of the Korean community in Mongolia. After the official address, President Lee and the First Lady completed the schedule with a group photo session with compatriot businesspeople and community representatives. (‘세계를 누비는 동포들이 대한민국 대도약의 주역입니다’라는 부제 아래 열린 이날 간담회에는 조현 외교부 장관, 위성락 국가안보실장, 구윤철 경제부총리, 배경훈 과기부총리, 권오을 국가보훈부 장관, 김경협 재외동포청장 등 정부 고위 관계자들과 재몽골 동포 80여 명이 참석했다.)

item.title: Joo Jin-woo: Police Concealed Jung Yi-han’s Staged Terror Hoax, Interfering in the Election (주진우 “정이한 테러 자작극 숨긴 경찰, 선거 개입”)
item.description:
Joo Jin-woo: Police Concealed Jung Yi-han’s Staged Terror Hoax, Interfering in the Election (주진우 “정이한 테러 자작극 숨긴 경찰, 선거 개입”)

People Power Party lawmaker Joo Jin-woo stated on the 10th regarding Reform Party’s Busan mayoral candidate Jung Yi-han’s “staged terror hoax” that “the police improperly interfered in the Busan mayoral election, and by splitting the conservative vote, they aided (Democratic Party) candidate Jeon Jae-soo’s victory.” He added, “I will file a criminal complaint against the police command chain on charges of abuse of authority, dereliction of duty, and violations of the Public Official Election Act.” (국민의힘 주진우 의원은 10일 개혁신당 정이한 부산시장 후보의 ‘테러 자작극’과 관련해 “경찰이 부산시장 선거에 부당하게 개입한 것이고, 보수표 분열을 통해 (민주당) 전재수 후보의 당선을 도운 것”이라며 “담당 경찰 지휘 라인을 직권남용, 직무 유기, 공직선거법 위반 등 혐의로 형사 고발하겠다”고 했다.)

In a press conference at the National Assembly, Joo said, “It has newly been revealed that the police already summoned and questioned Jung Yi-han in May, obtaining a confession regarding the staged terror hoax charges.” (주 의원은 이날 국회 기자회견에서 “지난 5월 경찰이 이미 정이한을 소환 조사해 테러 자작극 혐의에 대한 자백을 받았다는 사실이 새로 밝혀졌다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Joo claimed, “(Candidate Jung) wore a fake neck brace, posed as a terror victim, and split the conservative vote to the very end,” adding, “As a result, (People Power Party) candidate Park Hyung-joon lost the election.” He continued, “It is shocking that although Jung Yi-han showed up at the police station and confessed to the staged terror hoax, the police kept it hidden until after the election.” He further argued, “The police watched the crime scene in real time and actively aided Jung Yi-han’s election crimes.” (주 의원은 “(정 후보는) 가짜 목깁스를 하고, 테러 피해자를 자처하며 보수표를 끝까지 갈라친 것”이라며 “그로 인해 (국민의힘) 박형준 후보가 낙선한 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “정 후보가 경찰에 출석해 테러 자작극 혐의를 자백했는데도, 경찰이 선거가 끝날 때까지 숨겼다는 사실이 너무나 경악스럽다”며 “경찰이 범죄 현장을 실시간으로 지켜보며 정이한의 선거 범죄를 적극 도운 것”이라고 했다.)

Joo stated, “I believe the police actively assisted Jung Yi-han after he confessed to the staged terror hoax, allowing him to continue his act and commit additional crimes.” He added, “The confession about the staged terror hoax would have already been reported to the Blue House through the National Police Agency in May,” and asked, “We need to know how far up it was reported and why the police condoned the additional crime of letting him complete the campaign without informing the media.” (주 의원은 “정이한이 테러 자작극 범죄를 자백하고도 계속 쇼를 하며 추가 범죄를 하는데 경찰이 적극 조력했다고 생각한다”고 했다. 이어 “테러 자작극 자백은 5월에 이미 경찰청을 통해 청와대에 보고됐을 것”이라며 “어디까지 보고됐고, 언론에 알리지 않고 완주하는 추가 범죄를 왜 방조했는지 밝혀야 한다”고 했다.)

After the press conference, Joo told reporters, “I cannot trust the police, but due to loopholes in the current investigation system, I will file a complaint with the police. If the investigation does not proceed properly, I will strongly demand an investigation through a special counsel.” (주 의원은 회견 후 기자들과 만나 “경찰을 믿을 수 없지만 현재 수사 체계의 허점 때문에 (경찰에) 고소하고, 수사가 제대로 진행되지 않는다면 특검을 통해 수사할 것을 강력히 요구하겠다”고 했다.)

Regarding the Reform Party, Joo also said, “They must disclose when they became aware of this fact and take appropriate responsibility.” He noted, “I understand that Reform Party officials also went to support (the Busan mayoral campaign). While the candidate was being questioned by the police, election activities would have stopped—how could the campaign not have known?” He added, “I believe the facts must be clarified until the public is fully convinced.” (주 의원은 개혁신당과 관련해서도 “이 사실을 언제 인지했는지 밝혀 그에 합당한 책임을 져야 할 것”이라고 했다. 그는 “개혁신당 관계자들도 (부산시장 캠프에) 지원을 갔던 것으로 알고 있다. 후보자가 경찰 소환 조사를 받는 동안 선거운동이 중단됐을 텐데, 캠프에서 이를 몰랐겠느냐”며 “국민이 확실히 납득할 수 있을 때까지 사실관계가 규명돼야 한다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Government Pursues Abolition of Mandatory Reporting for Contacts with Chosen Soren Figures (정부, 조총련 인사 접촉시 신고 의무 폐지 추진)
item.description:
Government Pursues Abolition of Mandatory Reporting for Contacts with Chosen Soren Figures (정부, 조총련 인사 접촉시 신고 의무 폐지 추진)

The government is pushing forward with a plan to abolish the mandatory reporting requirement when South Korean citizens come into contact with members of the pro-Pyongyang General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chosen Soren). (정부가 우리 국민이 재일본조선인총연합회(조총련) 인사와 접촉할 때 신고의무를 폐지하는 방안을 추진한다.)

According to the Ministry of Unification on the 10th, the ministry plans to cooperate with the National Assembly to ensure that a revision to the "Act on Inter-Korean Exchange and Cooperation" (Inter-Korean Exchange and Cooperation Act), which deletes the clause treating Chosen Soren as North Korean residents, can be discussed during this year's regular parliamentary session. (10일 통일부에 따르면 통일부는 조총련을 북한 주민으로 간주하는 조항을 삭제한 ‘남북교류협력에 관한 법률’ (남북교류협력법) 개정안이 올해 정기국회에서 논의될 수 있도록 국회와 협력할 계획이다.)

Article 30 of the current Inter-Korean Exchange and Cooperation Act stipulates that "members of overseas organizations that act in accordance with North Korea's line are deemed to be residents of North Korea." Founded in 1955, Chosen Soren serves as an external organization of North Korea's Workers' Party, acting as a North Korean representative office in Japan. Legally, Chosen Soren is considered an anti-state organization. Under the current Inter-Korean Exchange and Cooperation Act, anyone wishing to contact Chosen Soren figures must report their contact plan to the government in advance, and if contact occurs unexpectedly, they must report it afterward. (현행 남북교류협력법 제30조는 “북한의 노선에 따라 활동하는 국외단체의 구성원은 북한의 주민으로 본다”고 규정하고 있다. 1955년 창설된 조총련은 북한 노동당의 외곽 조직으로 일본에서 북한대표부 역할을 한다. 조총련은 법적으로는 반국가단체에 해당한다. 현행 남북교류협력법은 조총련 인사와 접촉하려면 정부에 사전에 대북 접촉계획을 신고해야 하고 예상치 못하게 접촉하게 된 경우에는 사후에 신고하도록 되어 있다.)

The government explains that this move reflects changing realities, including the fact that Chosen Soren's size and influence have diminished compared to the past, and that a significant number of its members hold South Korean nationality. Recently, Chosen Soren revised its charter, deleting phrases such as "achieving independent peaceful reunification" and "respecting the June 15 Joint Declaration." Provisions from the previous charter that called for strengthening ties among South, North, and overseas compatriots, including a federation-style unification, were also removed during the revision, and the policy of solidarity and cooperation with the Korean Residents' Union in Japan (Mindan), a pro-Seoul Korean residents' organization, was abandoned. <<> Under the Yoon Suk Yeol administration, the Ministry of Unification had imposed fines on a civic group led by actor Kwon Hae-hyo (Montang Yeonpil, or "People Together with Joseon Schools") for engaging in "unauthorized contact" without reporting amid its support projects for pro-Pyongyang schools. Director Kim Ji-woon, who produced a documentary on discrimination against ethnic Koreans in Japan, was also investigated on the same charges and received a warning. (정부는 조총련의 규모와 영향력이 과거에 비해 감소했고 조총련 구성원 중에는 대한민국 국적자도 상당하다는 점 등 변화한 현실을 반영하겠다는 설명이다. 최근 조총련은 단체 강령에서 ‘자주적 평화통일 성취’나 ‘6·15 공동선언 존중’ 등의 문구를 삭제하는 등 강령을 개정했다. 과거 강령에 명시됐던 연방제 방식의 통일을 비롯한 남·북·해외 동포 간 유대 강화 조항도 개정 과정에서 모두 사라졌고 재일 한국인 단체인 재일본대한민국민단(민단)과의 연대·협력 방침도 폐기됐다.)

item.title: Chae Yi-bae, Former Democratic Party Emergency Committee Member, Appointed as Chief of Staff to Prime Minister Han Duck-soo (한성숙 총리 비서실장에 채이배 전 민주당 비대위원)
item.description:
Chae Yi-bae, Former Democratic Party Emergency Committee Member, Appointed as Chief of Staff to Prime Minister Han Duck-soo (한성숙 총리 비서실장에 채이배 전 민주당 비대위원)

On the 10th, former lawmaker Chae Yi-bae, who served on the Democratic Party of Korea's emergency committee, was appointed as the Chief of Staff to the Prime Minister (vice-ministerial level), supporting Prime Minister Han Duck-soo. (한성숙 국무총리를 보좌하는 국무총리비서실장(차관급)에 10일 더불어민주당 비상대책위원을 지낸 채이배 전 국회의원이 임명됐다.)

The Prime Minister's Office distributed a press release that afternoon, announcing that Chae would begin his term as the new Chief of Staff to the Prime Minister on the 11th. (총리실은 이날 오후 보도 자료를 배포해 채 의원이 11일 신임 총리비서실장으로 임기를 시작한다고 밝혔다.)

Born in 1975 in Gunsan, North Jeolla Province, Chief Chae graduated from Incheon Gyeyang High School and earned a degree in Public Administration from Korea University. He also completed a master's program in Commercial Law at Korea University's Graduate School of Law. Working as a certified public accountant, he served as a secretary for the Economic Democratization Committee at the People's Solidarity for Participatory Democracy, a research fellow at the Institute for Good Corporate Governance, and a research fellow at the Institute for Economic Reform. In 2016, he was elected as a proportional representative for the People's Party and served as a member of the 20th National Assembly. During his tenure as a lawmaker, he served as the chairman of the Policy Committee of the Bareunmirae Party, formed after the merger of the People's Party and the Bareun Party. (1975년 전북 군산에서 태어난 채 실장은 인천 계산고와 고려대 행정학과를 졸업했고, 고려대 법학대학원에서 상법 전공으로 석사과정을 수료했다. 공인회계사로 활동하면서 참여연대 경제민주화위원회 간사, 좋은기업지배연구소 연구위원, 경제개혁연구소 연구위원을 지냈다. 2016년 국민의당 비례대표로 당선돼 20대 국회의원을 지냈다. 의원 재임 중에는 국민의당과 바른정당이 바른미래당으로 합당하면서 바른미래당 정책위원회 의장을 지냈다.)

After his term as a lawmaker ended, he left the Minsaeng Party, the successor of the Bareunmirae Party, and joined the Democratic Party after being recruited by President Lee Jae-myung, then the party leader. He served as a special advisor for fair economy under Prime Minister Kim Boo-kyum during the Moon Jae-in administration. During the 20th presidential election in 2022, when President Lee competed against former President Yoon Suk Yeol, he served as the chairman of the Fair Market Committee under the election campaign committee, and later as a member of the Democratic Party's emergency committee formed after President Lee's defeat in the election. (의원 임기 종료 후에는 바른미래당의 후신인 민생당을 탈당했고, 민주당 대표였던 이재명 대통령의 영입으로 민주당에 입당했다. 문재인 정부 김부겸 총리의 공정경제특별보좌관을 지냈다. 이 대통령이 윤석열 전 대통령과 경쟁한 2022년 20대 대선에서는 선거대책위원회 공정시장위원장, 이 대통령의 대선 패배 이후 구성된 민주당 비상대책위원회에서 위원을 지냈다.)

Chief Chae is known to have first met Prime Minister Han, then the CEO of Naver, while serving on the National Assembly's Political Affairs Committee during his time as a lawmaker. (채 실장은 의원 시절 국회 정무위원회에서 활동하면서 당시 네이버 대표였던 한 총리와 처음 만난 것으로 알려졌다.)

The Prime Minister's Office evaluated the new Chief Chae as "an economic expert with political acumen who has worked to alleviate polarization by fostering a fair competitive environment and promoting sustainable economic growth." (총리실은 신임 채 실장에 대해 “공정한 경쟁 환경을 조성하고 지속 가능한 경제 성장을 통해 양극화 완화를 위해 노력해 온 정무적 감각을 겸비한 경제 전문가”라고 평가했다.)

It added, "Based on this experience and expertise, Chief Chae is expected to support Prime Minister Han, who has emphasized growth for all citizens, in areas such as recovering the people's livelihood economy and facilitating major transitions like AX (AI transformation) and GX (green transformation), thereby contributing to achieving tangible national policy outcomes that the public can feel." (이어 “채 실장은 이러한 경력과 전문성을 바탕으로, 국민 모두의 성장을 강조해 온 한 총리를 보좌해 민생 경제 회복, AX(인공지능 전환)·GX(녹색 전환) 대전환 등을 지원해 국민께서 체감할 수 있는 국정 성과를 도출하는 데 기여할 것으로 기대된다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee Jae-myung to Host Real Estate Forum on the 23rd... Kim Yong-beom Says "Reviewing Improvements to Holding Taxes and Transaction Taxes" (李대통령 주재로 23일 부동산토론회... 김용범 “보유세·거래세 개선 검토”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung to Host Real Estate Forum on the 23rd... Kim Yong-beom Says "Reviewing Improvements to Holding Taxes and Transaction Taxes" (李대통령 주재로 23일 부동산토론회... 김용범 “보유세·거래세 개선 검토”)

President Lee Jae-myung will hold a forum on the 23rd to directly listen to and discuss public opinions on overall real estate policies. Kim Yong-beom, Chief of the Presidential Office Policy Office, announced the forum schedule during a briefing on the 10th, stating, "The government does not believe it has all the answers," adding, "We will listen more to voices from the field and actively embrace better alternatives." (이재명 대통령이 오는 23일 부동산 정책 전반에 대한 국민 의견을 직접 듣고 논의하는 토론회를 연다. 김용범 청와대 정책실장은 10일 브리핑을 통해 토론회 일정을 공개하면서 “정부가 정답을 다 알고 있다고 여기지 않는다”며 “현장의 목소리를 더 많이 듣고 더 좋은 대안은 적극적으로 받아들이겠다”고 말했다.)

In his opening remarks that day, Chief Kim said, "Recently, public concerns surrounding the real estate market are growing," and "The government does not believe that real estate policies can be completed solely based on the government's judgment." He added, "Market conditions are constantly changing, and the difficulties experienced by the public are diverse," emphasizing, "What is needed now is not for the government to unilaterally present answers, but for the public and experts to create solutions together." The intent is to fully listen to public opinions and reflect them in real estate policies ahead of the scheduled announcement of tax reform plans as early as the end of this month. (김 실장은 이날 모두발언에서 “최근 부동산 시장을 둘러싼 국민 여러분의 걱정이 커지고 있다”며 “정부는 부동산 정책이 정부의 판단만으로 완성될 수 있다고 생각하지 않는다”고 했다. 이어 “시장 여건은 계속 변하고 있고, 국민이 체감하는 어려움도 다양하다”며 “지금 필요한 것은 정부가 일방적으로 답을 제시하는 것이 아니라, 국민과 전문가가 함께 해법을 만들어가는 과정”이라고 했다. 이르면 이달 말 세제 개편안 발표 등에 앞서, 국민 의견을 충분히 듣고 부동산 정책에 반영하겠다는 취지다.)

This forum is expected to primarily discuss real estate supply measures, as well as tax issues such as holding taxes and transaction taxes, and difficulties in securing a home of one's own due to increases in jeonse and monthly rent prices and lending regulations. (이번 토론회에서는 부동산 공급 대책은 물론, 보유세와 거래세 등 세금 문제, 전·월세 가격 인상과 대출 규제로 인한 내 집 마련 어려움 등이 주로 논의될 것으로 보인다.)

In this regard, Chief Kim stated, "The government has been promoting policies under the principle of expanding supply and stabilizing the market," adding, "Supply plans are being carried out without disruption, and necessary market stabilization measures are being implemented in parallel for concerns of overheating in some areas, such as the recent designation of land transaction permit zones in Dongtan, Giheung, and Guri." He continued, "Furthermore, regarding the overall tax system, including holding taxes and transaction taxes, we are reviewing reasonable improvement measures based on research services and overseas cases." (이와 관련, 김 실장은 “정부는 그동안 공급 확대와 시장 안정이라는 원칙 아래 정책을 추진해 왔다”며 “공급 계획은 차질 없이 추진하고 있으며, 최근 동탄·기흥·구리 등에 대한 토지거래허가구역 지정 등과 같이 일부 지역의 과열 우려에 대해서는 필요한 시장 안정 조치를 병행하고 있다”고 했다. 이어 “아울러 보유세와 거래세 등 세제 전반에 대해서도 연구용역과 해외 사례 등을 토대로 합리적인 개선 방안을 검토하고 있다”고 했다.)

Ahead of the forum chaired by the President, relevant ministries will first hold forums to discuss key areas. From the 14th to the 16th, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the Financial Services Commission, and the Ministry of Economy and Finance will hold forums on the topics of supply, finance, and taxation, respectively. (대통령 주재 토론회에 앞서 관련 부처들이 먼저 토론회를 열어 주요 분야에 관해 논의한다. 14일부터 16일까지 국토교통부, 금융위원회, 재정경제부가 각각 공급, 금융, 세제를 주제로 토론회를 연다.)

Meanwhile, in response to a question about the side effects of "single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs)" after the briefing, Chief Kim said, "On this topic, the Ministry of Economy and Finance, the Financial Services Commission, the Bank of Korea, and the Financial Supervisory Service are closely monitoring and considering the market situation," adding, "We will closely examine whether there is any market impact, and if supplementation is deemed necessary, we will discuss and make a decision." This remark comes amid continued criticism over the significant side effects that ETFs allowing for 2x betting on movements in Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix stock prices are having on the stock market. <<>> (한편 김 실장은 이날 브리핑 뒤 ‘단일 종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF)’의 부작용 관련 질문에 대해 “이 주제에 대해서는 재정경제부, 금융위, 한국은행, 금융감독원이 시장 상황을 면밀히 보고 고민하고 있다”며 “시장 영향이 있는지 면밀히 살펴보고, 보완이 필요하다고 하면 논의해서 결정하지 않을까 싶다”고 말했다. 최근 삼성전자, SK하이닉스 주가 움직임에 2배를 베팅할 수 있는 ETF가 주식 시장에 미치는 부작용이 크다는 지적이 계속되는 데 대한 언급이다.)

item.title: Rep. Jang Blocked Again at National Police Agency Entrance... Meeting with Acting Police Chief Falls Through (경찰청 입구에서 또 제지당한 張... 경찰청장 직대 면담도 불발)
item.description:
Rep. Jang Blocked Again at National Police Agency Entrance... Meeting with Acting Police Chief Falls Through (경찰청 입구에서 또 제지당한 張... 경찰청장 직대 면담도 불발)

People Power Party (PPP) Representative Jang Dong-hyuk visited the National Police Agency to protest allegations of poor investigation and cover-up by police regarding the "Murder of a High School Girl in Gwangju, South Jeolla Province," but was blocked at the entrance, following a similar incident at the Gwangju Police Agency. The police, who had prevented entry the previous day citing the absence of the commissioner, stated this time, "In accordance with the building's security regulations, media coverage is not permitted." After about 50 minutes of standoff, the meeting between the PPP leadership and the acting National Police Agency commissioner fell through. <<> Rep. Jang was scheduled to meet with Acting Commissioner Yoo Jae-sung at the National Police Agency in Migeun-dong, Seodaemun-gu, Seoul, at 4:00 PM that day. However, he was blocked in the agency's lobby and unable to proceed to the office. <<> A police official explained, "We are fully willing to hold meetings with lawmakers and plan to humbly listen to any criticisms they raise," but added, "According to the building's access and security regulations, journalists and aides cannot enter." At the scene, Rep. Jang was accompanied by Supreme Council Member Shin Dong-wook, Secretary-General Jeong Hee-yong, Chief of the Party Leader's Office Park Jun-tae, and lawmakers Jo Bae-sook, Joo Jin-woo, and Park Seong-hoon. <<> All PPP lawmakers requested that at least their opening remarks be made available to the press. Rep. Jang said, "If Acting Commissioner Yoo finds it difficult to speak, I will allow just my opening remarks to be released to the press and then proceed with the rest of the meeting behind closed doors," adding, "If it's not disclosed to the media, the public won't see that I am conveying their concerns on their behalf to the acting commissioner." Supreme Council Member Shin Dong-wook also urged, "Please allow even just the opening remarks to be covered." <<> Rep. Jang requested that if security were the issue, the meeting could take place in the lobby, but that too was rejected. He then said to a police official, "Then let's just have the meeting right here in the lobby," and added, "I want to convey my concerns based on what has already been reported to the media and hear how you plan to resolve this. If you say internal matters are confidential, then come out here and answer." <<> However, the police insisted on a private meeting with PPP lawmakers excluding the media, and the meeting ultimately collapsed. <<> About 50 minutes after arriving at the agency, Rep. Jang decided to leave. He told reporters, "If even we, as lawmakers, cannot get past this door, how can ordinary citizens ever cross its threshold?" adding, "It will inflict far greater humiliation and shame on citizens." He continued, "The issue is not just the supplementary investigative authority; the police themselves need to be overhauled and reformed from the ground up." <<> He further stated, "It's not shocking that this police force would gain full investigative authority; what's shocking is that they have been conducting investigations while claiming to protect the safety and lives of the people all along," adding, "This kind of attitude is where the recklessness, shamelessness, and audacity to destroy evidence, manipulate incidents, and downplay murder cases involving their own come from." <<> Supreme Council Member Shin Dong-wook said, "Starting in October, the police will hold all investigative authority. The public is witnessing the preview of that in every detail," and added, "I don't believe this issue will end with just a protest like this." He went on, "If they have any conscience, the head of the Gwangju Police Agency and the acting National Police Agency commissioner should resign immediately—that's their duty to the people." <<> Meanwhile, earlier that day, lawmakers from the Democratic Party, including Kim Young-jin, chairman of the National Assembly's Public Administration and Security Committee, visited the National Police Agency and met with Acting Commissioner Yoo Jae-sung. (국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 ‘전남광주 여고생 피살 사건’과 관련해 경찰의 부실 수사, 은폐 의혹에 대해 항의하기 위해 경찰청을 찾았지만 광주경찰청에 이어 입구에서 제지당했다. 전날 청장이 없다는 이유로 청사 진입을 막았던 경찰은 이날은 “청사 보안 규정에 따라 언론 취재는 어렵다”고 했다. 결국 약 50분 간의 실랑이 끝에 국민의힘 지도부와 경찰청장 직무대행 면담은 무산됐다.)

item.title: President Lee Presents Traditional Korean Bow Set to Mongolian President (李대통령, 몽골 대통령에 국궁세트 선물)
item.description:
The presidential office announced on the 10th that President Lee Jae-myung, who is on a state visit to Mongolia, presented a set of traditional Korean bows and a smartwatch to Mongolian President Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh. (몽골을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 10일 오흐나 후렐수흐 몽골 대통령에게 국궁 세트와 스마트 워치를 선물했다고 청와대가 밝혔다.)

The traditional bow set was crafted using traditional methods by bonding water buffalo horn and bamboo. Archery is not only one of the three main events of the Naadam Festival, Mongolia's largest holiday, but also a traditional culture shared by both Korea and Mongolia, so the bow set was chosen as a gift for President Khürelsükh. President Lee also delivered a smartwatch equipped with the latest features, tailored to President Khürelsükh's taste, who enjoys exercise in his daily life. (국궁 세트는 물소뿔, 대나무를 접합해 전통 기법으로 제작했다. 활쏘기는 몽골 최대 명절인 나담 축제의 3대 종목 중 하나일 뿐만 아니라 한-몽골 양국이 공유하는 전통 문화라는 점에서 국궁 세트를 후렐수흐 대통령에 대한 선물로 정해졌다. 이 대통령은 평소 운동을 즐기는 후렐수흐 대통령의 취향에 맞춰 최신 기능이 탑재된 스마트 워치도 전달했다.)

In addition, First Lady Berlerchechek was presented with a butterfly and vine-patterned mother-of-pearl lacquerware box in a jade color reminiscent of Mongolia's vast grasslands and abundant nature. The mother-of-pearl box is decorated with butterfly and vine patterns. The presidential office explained that the butterfly, symbolizing happiness and prosperity, and the endlessly sprawling vine represent prosperity and longevity. (아울러 벌러르체첵 여사에게는 몽골의 광활한 초원과 풍요로운 자연이 연상되는 비취색을 사용한 나비당초 나전함을 선물했다. 나전함은 나비와 당초(덩굴) 문양으로 장식됐다. 행복과 번영을 상징하는 나비와 끝없이 뻗어나가는 덩굴은 번영과 장수를 의미한다고 청와대는 설명했다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee attended a state banquet hosted by President Khürelsükh on the same day. The banquet was attended by business figures such as LS Group Chairman Koo Ja-eun, SK Vice Chairman Lee Hyung-hee, GS Retail CEO Heo Seo-hong, and Emart CEO Han Chae-yang, along with heads of institutions including KOTRA President Kang Kyung-sung and Korea Eximbank President Hwang Ki-yeon. (한편 이 대통령은 이날 후렐수흐 대통령 주최 국빈만찬에 참석한다. 만찬에는 구자은 LS 회장, 이형희 SK 부회장, 허서홍 GS리테일 대표, 한채양 이마트 대표 등 기업인과 강경성 대한무역투자진흥공사(KOTRA) 사장, 황기연 한국수출입은행장 등 기관장이 참석한다.)

The banquet menu featured smoked salmon and beef tongue appetizers, tomato and bell pepper cream soup, halibut fillet, and braised beef brisket. (만찬 메뉴로는 훈제 연어와 우설 전채, 토마토와 피망 크림수프, 할리벗 필레, 소뽈살 찜이 제공된다.)
